v: pu॰ heti SabdaM jahAti hA--kvip । ganDarvaBede SabdamA॰
m: 1. हहा ind. an exclamation (= ‘alas!’ in हहा धिक्), Ratnāv.
2. हहा m. N. of a Gandharva (mc. for हाहा), MBh.; R.
a: हहा — m. A kind of Gandharva; cf. हाहा.

m: हहाल m. pl. N. of the Caidya country, L.

v: avya॰ heti halati । hAlAhale sTAvaravizaBede Sabdaca॰ ।
m: हहल n. a sort of deadly poison (cf. हलाहल), L.
a: हहलं — A kind of deadly poison.

m: हहव n. a partic. hell (cf. हाहव), Buddh.
